messages.subject: redirecting request from a brewed page
messages.subject_clean: redirecting request from a brewed page
messages.body_plain:
Dear rApache users,

I am serving a Rook web application through rapache.

I would like to create an rhtml page that 1. executes an R function ( let's say 'sessionInfo()' )
and 2. passes on the request on to another page.

For example, processing the following code through a 'Brewery' rook application

<% sessionInfo() %>
<% res$redirect("my_final_page.rhtml") %>

works when I use the internal web server.
But unfortunately, rapache does not perform the redirect.

Any hints ?

Thanks a lot,
Thomas

Oh I didn't notice the Segmentation fault yet. That looks nasty. Could
be a problem in R or RApache. Did you compile R yourself or did you
grab some binary? You can try reinstalling the packages and recompile
rapache.

There were some problems in the past with older distributions, but
those got resolved when upgrading to more recent distro's. See e.g:
https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups=#!searchin/rapache/%22segmentation$20fault%22/rapache/kf9qO60xM-g/IoxMlvdNHF8J

I don't think a lot of people use rapache (or R for that matter) on
suse, so you're a bit in unexplored territory. I have tested rapache
myself on Debian, Ubuntu and CentOS, so if possible I would recommend
switching to either of these.

I reinstalled R  compiled from source and as a shared library (using ./configure --enable-R-shlib, followed by make and make install). It has been placed in the /usr/local/lib64 directory (which is different than the one for the binary distribution packaged by SuSE that remains in /urs/lib64)

I then recompiled and installed RApache from the latest source distribution using
./configure \
    --with-R=/usr/local/lib64/R/bin/R \
    --with-apache2-apxs=/usr/sbin/apxs2
make
make install

This replaces the previous version of RApache in /usr/lib64/apache2/mod_R.so which I had compiled against the binary and probabily static version of R that came with SuSE.

Unfortunately nothing changed.

lrwxrwxrwx  1 root root       16 Nov 10 21:54 libicuuc.so -> libicuuc.so.50.1
lrwxrwxrwx  1 root root       16 Nov 20 20:12 libicuuc.so.49 -> libicuuc.so.50.1
